name: Polygon.io (Massive)
tagline: Stock market API with real-time and historical tick data via REST and WebSockets.
description: Polygon.io (rebranded Massive in late 2025) provides financial market data APIs for US stocks, options, forex, crypto, indices, and futures. Developers can query historical and real-time aggregates, trades, quotes, reference data, and more over REST, WebSocket streams, and flat files. Existing api.polygon.io endpoints and API keys remain supported in parallel with the new api.massive.com base.

auth.details: API key via query parameter ?apiKey=YOUR_API_KEY or Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY header; self-serve signup at dashboard.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 5 API requests per minute; delayed data (not real-time); limited historical depth on free plans
pricing.paid_plans: Starter from ~$29/mo; higher tiers for real-time data and unlimited requests — see pricing page

rate_limits: Free: 5 requests/minute. Paid: unlimited API requests (recommend staying under 100 req/s to avoid throttling).
use_cases: get daily OHLCV bars for a stock ticker
fetch real-time or delayed stock quotes
list ticker reference data and company details
retrieve forex or crypto exchange rates
